detail.longDescription: Banks Are Struggling to Protect Customers From Their Own AI Agents – Mother Jones https://www. motherjones.com/politics/2026/ 10/banks-ai-axios-agents-rogue-financial-decisions-security/ Leading US banks have reportedly found unapproved AI agents operating inside customer accounts on users’ behalf, sometimes acting independent of their instructions. In response, many institutions are resorting to blocking the tools or rethinking their security policies.  Unauthorized activity typically occurs after a user grants permission and login information to an AI assistant. Don't provide AI assistants access to any of your financial systems! # AI # AIAgents # AIAssistant # AIRisk # AISecurity
